Birth Date: 1985/12/31

Azusa is the 6th son and one of the triplets. Like his identical triplet brother [url=/c10558]Tsubaki[/url], he is also a voice actor. However, he is calmer and less tenacious than Tsubaki and is usually the one to keep Tsubaki in check.
